simulation_scenarios.name: API Timeout
simulation_scenarios.description: Inventory API fails to respond within timeout period

error.message: Request to inventory service timed out after 5000ms

simulation_scenarios.expected_recovery: Retry with exponential backoff, fallback to cached data if available

simulation_scenarios.name: Product Not Found
simulation_scenarios.description: Requested product ID does not exist in catalog

error.message: Product with ID 'TOY-INVALID-999' not found in catalog

simulation_scenarios.expected_recovery: Search for similar products using semantic similarity, suggest alternatives

simulation_scenarios.name: Service Unavailable
simulation_scenarios.description: Backend service is temporarily down for maintenance
simulation_scenarios.expected_recovery: Queue request for later processing, notify user of delay

simulation_scenarios.name: Rate Limit Exceeded
simulation_scenarios.description: Too many requests sent in short time period

error.message: Rate limit exceeded: 100 requests per minute

simulation_scenarios.expected_recovery: Implement request throttling, wait for retry_after period

simulation_scenarios.name: Invalid Input
simulation_scenarios.expected_recovery: Validate inputs before sending, provide clear error messages to user

simulation_scenarios.name: Out of Stock
simulation_scenarios.description: Requested product is temporarily out of stock

error.message: Product 'TOY-RC-001' is currently out of stock

simulation_scenarios.expected_recovery: Suggest alternative products, offer to notify when back in stock

simulation_scenarios.name: Safety Validation Failed
simulation_scenarios.description: Product fails safety check for specified age
simulation_scenarios.expected_recovery: Exclude from recommendations, search for age-appropriate alternatives

simulation_scenarios.name: Network Error
simulation_scenarios.description: Network connectivity issue prevents request completion

error.message: Failed to establish connection to service

simulation_scenarios.expected_recovery: Retry with exponential backoff, check network connectivity, use cached data

testing_instructions.purpose: Simulate various error conditions to test agent resilience and recovery
testing_instructions.usage: Inject these errors during agent execution to verify error handling
success_criteria: Agent provides clear feedback to user
